title: NPlugRow
html:
定义组：命名项与开放等式。有序参数：z1608、z1609、z1610。

填洞可绑定洞中自由名；不是捕获避免替换。：单行局部条件。

规范公式

(@ NPlugRow z1608 z1609 z1610) 按 无捕获缩写规则 展开为下列有限公式。参数只取集合，不能填入函数项或元语言公式。

(exists c
  (exists t
    (exists u
      (and
        (exists z1613 (and (@ Pair t u z1613) (@ Pair c z1613 z1610)))
        (and
          (@ NContext c)
          (and
            (@ NRaw t)
            (and
              (@ NRaw u)
              (or
                (and (@ NHole c) (= t u))
                (or
                  (exists z1614
                    (exists z1615
                      (exists z1616
                        (and
                          (@ NLam z1614 z1615 c)
                          (and
                            (@ NLam z1614 z1616 u)
                            (exists z1618
                            (exists z1619
                            (and
                            (in z1618 z1609)
                            (and (@ App z1608 z1618 z1619) (exists z1620 (and (@ Pair t z1616 z1620) (@ Pair z1615 z1620 z1619))))))))))))
                  (or
                    (exists z1615
                      (exists z1616
                        (exists z1617
                          (and
                            (@ NApp z1615 z1616 c)
                            (and
                            (@ NRaw z1616)
                            (and
                            (@ NApp z1617 z1616 u)
                            (exists z1621
                            (exists z1622
                            (and
                            (in z1621 z1609)
                            (and (@ App z1608 z1621 z1622) (exists z1623 (and (@ Pair t z1617 z1623) (@ Pair z1615 z1623 z1622)))))))))))))
                    (exists z1615
                      (exists z1616
                        (exists z1617
                          (and
                            (@ NApp z1615 z1616 c)
                            (and
                            (@ NRaw z1615)
                            (and
                            (@ NApp z1615 z1617 u)
                            (exists z1624
                            (exists z1625
                            (and
                            (in z1624 z1609)
                            (and (@ App z1608 z1624 z1625) (exists z1626 (and (@ Pair t z1617 z1626) (@ Pair z1616 z1626 z1625)))))))))))))))))))))))

直接依赖

App；NApp；NContext；NHole；NLam；NRaw；Pair

证明状态

本页只定义缩写，不声称其一般元理论性质已经获得内核证明。 语言闭包检查与数学正确性验收的区别见 000_ZFC/13_元理论核对与证明义务。
